messages:
Elaine: Heads-up — planning to promote feature branch -> staging canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a final go/no-go and a rollback-readiness check. Who's taking smoke and who will run rollback if needed?

Sid: I can own smoke at +10m after traffic ramp. What exact checks do you want me to run?

Jen: Quick checklist for smoke please: 1) /v1/generate basic flow, 2) latency target p50 <200ms p95 <500ms, 3) error rate <0.5% on canary (start at 5% traffic). Also verify streaming and function-calling paths.

Mike: I will be primary rollback runner. Can someone paste the canonical rollback command and confirm where cache invalidation lives?

Arthur: Rollback steps in runbook — short version:
```
# revert manifests
kubectl -n rwd apply -f /manifests/rollbacks/rollback-to-v1.yaml
# invalidate model KV cache
./scripts/invalidate_cache --env=staging --model=v2
```
If the rollback script errors, escalate to infra oncall @sid and follow the fallback in the runbook.

Jen: Also remember to revert gateway routing after apply: `rw gateway route set --model v1 --weight 100`

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-18T09:00:00-07:00 (ID: 20260318-staging-canary). Auto-health-checks enabled.

qa-pipeline: QA smoke checklist (automated + manual): token limit test, streaming sanity, KV cache warm, rate-limit behavior, basic auth + metrics. Script we run: `scripts/smoke/staging_canary_smoke.sh` (posts JSON results).

Elaine: Owners: Smoke -> Sid; Rollback exec -> Mike; Gate decision after 15m smoke -> Elaine + Jen. Abort criteria: p95 > 800ms OR error rate > 1% OR streaming failures.

Sid: Sounds good. I'll post smoke results and the short metrics snapshot in this thread as they run.

Mike: One more ask: ensure the rollback runbook has SRE/infra pager/contact info. Added the phone + slack escalation lines to the doc. Link in handbook.

Jen: :thumbsup: Added a traffic ramp: 5% -> 25% in 10m steps, validate key metrics at each step. Will call it out in the canary playbook.

Arthur: Quick sanity helper for staging: `curl -sS https://staging.redwood/api/health | jq .` returns {"ok":true, "latency_ms":...} — useful for quick checks.

Elaine: Final Q: any DB migrations with this deploy?

Sid: No migrations in this release — app-only.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window starts in 30m.

Elaine: Thanks all. We'll run async unless a blocker pops. I'll post the final go/no-go here 5m before the window starts. :raised_hands:
